def solve(n, cache={}):
    if n in cache:
        return cache[n]
    if n <= 11:
        cache[n] = min(n, 2 + (11 - n))
        return cache[n]
    val = 1
    count = 1
    while val <= n:
        val = val * 10 + 1
        count += 1
    limit = val // 10
    if val > 2 * n:
        quotient = n // limit
        rem = n % limit
        res1 = solve(val - n, cache) + count
        res2 = quotient * (count - 1) + solve(rem, cache)
        cache[n] = min(res1, res2)
        return cache[n]
    else:
        quotient = n // limit
        rem = n % limit
        res1 = solve(val - n, cache) + count
        res2 = quotient * (count - 1) + solve(rem, cache)
        cache[n] = min(res1, res2)
        return cache[n]

input_value = int(input())
